apps.name: Beamline
apps.short_description: Bring curated CRT, LCD and VHS looks into supported games. Set up a game in Beamline, launch it as usual, and tune the picture from the in-game overlay.

apps.name: BordQ
apps.short_description: Soundboard, AI voice changer, live browser audio, and phone remote — one Windows app, one payment. Works with Discord, OBS, Zoom, and any game. No subscription.

apps.name: Dashvera HUD
apps.short_description: Dashvera HUD is a customizable Windows 11 desktop utility for monitoring CPU, RAM, GPU, and storage information. Keep essential system readings in view, personalize your HUD, and access useful tools including a built-in clock and calculator.

apps.name: Room Planner - Design Home 3D
apps.short_description: If you just bought a house or an apartment or want to decorate your existing property, we can help you do it easier, with less hustle and achieve better results in less time for the little fraction of total expense.

apps.name: Mushroom Man and the Problematic Pizza Parlour Playtest
A Red Specter Haunts the World – Free Sample
apps.short_description: Build a highly organized Communist Party with iron discipline; seize power through armed struggle; liberate all oppressed people; and march toward the fulfillment and realization of the Party’s highest goals and ultimate ideals

apps.name: Animals League Unite Demo
apps.short_description: Play the whole first world: 10 Meadow levels for 2 to 8 players, on one screen or online. Stack up, shout, fall together, then make your own levels in the level editor.

apps.name: Come to my party! Demo
apps.short_description: Jimin dreams of finally having her first birthday party, but what begins as a childhood wish unravels into social pressure, fragile friendships, family expectations, and consequences that hit closer than you’d like. Join Jimin in this coming of age story where every choice carries weight.

apps.name: Crownmarked Demo
apps.short_description: Rebuild a fallen kingdom, raise citizens into adventurers and fight beside powerful companions in Crownmarked, a kingdom-building action RPG set in a fractured fantasy world trapped in an endless cycle of destruction and rebirth.

apps.name: Crystant Demo
apps.short_description:
Crystant is a strategy survival game that combines board game-style exploration, turn-based tactical combat, and Roguelite progression.
Explore the floors, manage resources, strengthen your team, and fight against mutated creatures.

apps.name: DISK-Y Demo
apps.short_description: Show transfer student Yuu around the school in a short psychological horror visual novel with a dreamlike, disjointed story. An experimental retro game originally made for a single 3.5-inch floppy disk, now on Steam.

apps.name: Escape from Doomstown Demo
apps.short_description: A post-apocalyptic survival game where you lead a squad of survivors into a zombie-infested town. Scavenge for supplies, take down dangerous foes, and get out before the horde closes in. Build your base, recruit survivors, strengthen your squad, and fight your way out of this doomed city!

apps.name: Estancia Protocol Zero Demo
apps.short_description: A first-person survival horror set in Neuquén, Argentine Patagonia. Venture into a remote estate in Cerro Ocaso to search for your missing partner. Face hordes of the undead, manage your resources, and solve classic puzzles to survive the nightmare.

apps.name: GEKOKUJO: Vagrant Crown Demo
apps.short_description: Your first step into a living world. This free demo of GEKOKUJO: Vagrant Crown is being prepared around third-person exploration, village and forest encounters, and the beginning of a journey with a wolf companion.

apps.name: Inearth Demo
apps.short_description: A tactical turn-based roguelite with environmental interactions, spellcrafting, and deckbuilding. Descend into the Hollow Earth. As above, so below.

apps.name: Maria IV: A Cozy Botanical Sim Demo
apps.short_description: What would life look like as a florist on Pont Notre-Dame in late 15th-century Paris? Personalize your home and shop, carry on your legacy, and grow flowers using real cultivation principles. The final page of the Guide Book may just be the first page of your real-life botanical journey.

apps.name: Me and You Demo
apps.short_description:
Me and You is a co-op puzzle game inspired by the acclaimed “Baba Is You”. 
Create, change and break the rules of each level to solve it together.

apps.name: Memory House Demo
apps.short_description: Your first quiet evening in Memory House. Try illustrated Jigsaw puzzles, an introductory Atlas strategy scenario, five detective chapters, a complete fairy tale, and a small personal journal, with music and changing weather. Available in English and Russian.

apps.name: Mind Vessel Demo
apps.short_description: An autobattler roguelike in which you are a Vessel formed by the unification of dead people's spirits. Dismember and graft them to customize their abilities, as you use them to find a way out of the void.

apps.name: Moving Castle Demo
apps.short_description: Build a moving castle—or a vast mobile city—and explore a post-apocalyptic world. Live aboard your creation: gather, mine, explore and fight. Travel with your residents, face fearsome monsters, grow crops, cook meals, and share sunrises and sunsets.

apps.name: NARNOK: Feed Grommy Candy Demo
apps.short_description:
A push-your-luck roguelike sackbuilder where you feed candy to a worm called Grommy.
Draw candies from your sack, chain their effects, and feed Gromintler BUT NOT TOO SWEET!

apps.name: Omanah Demo
apps.short_description: Myst-Like 3D free exploration game. This demo allows you to play the first part of the game, which features 8 additional worlds in the full version.

apps.name: Oreship Stellar Frontier Demo
apps.short_description: Baue Rohstoffe im All ab, erweitere dein Frachtschiff und errichte Produktionsketten, Stationen und Handelsrouten. In Oreship Stellar Frontier wächst dein Weltraumimperium Schritt für Schritt über mehrere Sternensysteme hinweg.

apps.name: Palehollow Hospital | 灰谷医院 Demo
apps.short_description: This is a first-person indie horror game. You play as a video blogger exploring an abandoned hospital, uncovering the dark secrets hidden within its walls.

apps.name: Pocket Aquarium 方寸水族 Demo
Re:Connect Demo
apps.short_description: Re:Connect is a programming puzzle adventure set in a digital world, where you connect code to change the rules! Become a Debug AI, solve electronic circuit puzzles, and set off on a grand adventure to repair the “Heart Bugs” of the AIs!

apps.name: Rites of Accord Demo
apps.short_description:
Outsmart your rival and win a full wargame in 30 minutes. Or attempt survival against (nearly) endless hordes.

Command six factions that play nothing alike: turn your enemy's dead into ghosts that hunt them, spread living terrain across the map, or form choirs to share damage with allies.

apps.name: River Drift Demo
apps.short_description: Paddle in sync or sink together. River Drift is a chaotic co-op rafting game where you and a friend fight wildlife, repair your raft mid-river, and survive deadly branching routes. Teamwork is optional, panic is guaranteed!

apps.name: Rock Band Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: A first-person rock band life sim where you explore a gritty 1990s neighbourhood, play rhythm-based concerts, get into fights, make bad decisions, and somehow keep your band together.

apps.name: SOLITAIRE.EXE: A Roguelike on the Night Shift Demo
apps.short_description: Remember Windows Solitaire? Try a free week of outrageous combos, plugins and performance reviews. Open ZONE.EXE for NERTZ RUSH and SPIT with Steam friends or bots. TRAINING.EXE limits the content, never your playtime. Your trial shift starts here.

apps.name: Speed Golf Royale Demo
apps.short_description: Play Quick Match online or over LAN with up to 20 players (bots fill empty spots) across all 8 current courses. It includes the tutorial, power-ups and character customisation. The Level Editor, extra game modes and Steam stats and achievements are only in the full game.

apps.name: Spirit of Diwata Demo
apps.short_description: Heal instead of fight. A cozy co-op JRPG for up to three, on one screen or online, set in an Asian fantasy world where you play elemental spirit instruments to calm the creatures you meet. Every creature is someone to bond with, and each friendship brings a little more hope to the world.

apps.name: Stop Reading the Cards Demo
apps.short_description: Build a deck. Let the cards do the work. Try the demo of this satirical roguelike card game, with automated combat, a guided tutorial, and keyboard & mouse controls. Camera-based gestures are optional. Management accepts no responsibility for your strategy.

apps.name: Summoner's Tale Demo
apps.short_description:
Summoner’s Tale is an Action-Platformer monster collecting game in a new way!
Collect Monsters, discover their unique abilities, build your dream squad and fight your way to save the world!

apps.name: Sunset Painter Demo
apps.short_description: Have you ever wanted to spray an entire can of whipped cream into the sky and watch the sun's golden rays dance through your masterpiece as day melts into dusk? Craft the perfect sky - spray, sculpt, and swirl volumetric clouds with delightfully tactile tools. No pressure, just you and the sky.

apps.name: The Aether Project TD Demo
apps.short_description: The Aether Project TD is a classic 3D tower defense game built around tower placement, upgrades, varied enemy threats, active abilities, and different ways of surviving each level. Defend against structured waves or continuous attacks, adapt your defenses, and hold the line.

apps.name: The Little Stomping Girl Demo
apps.short_description: Tiny stomps. Explosive combos! Mine ore before your match burns out in this incremental mining game. Fit gear into limited equipment slots, collect unique items, and combine skills to turn a little girl's stomps into powerful chain reactions. Light another match, grow stronger, and dig deeper!

apps.name: This Is the Peace Demo
apps.short_description: One shift. Seven seats. Far too many egos. Try the first day of this satirical dispatch strategy: build your team, handle 15 calls, open diplomatic talks, and discover why the President's phone is everyone's problem.

apps.name: Trailblazers: Into the March Demo
apps.short_description: Embark on a thrilling adventure in this roguelite colony-sim strategy game. Command your Landship in tactical battles, care for a crew composed of all sorts of characters, shape your home, manage resources, and lead expeditions into the March. Discover what lies at its heart... and in yours.

apps.name: Voxel Playground Demo
apps.short_description: Voxel Playground is a physics-driven voxel sandbox VR game built for VR. In this fully destructible voxel physics world, you can build, craft and shoot against enemies with limitless possibilities.

apps.name: 东隅荡寇志·朝鲜战争 Demo
未春节 Festival of Unborn Spring Demo
apps.short_description: In Kunming, Yunnan, during her first winter break after entering high school, a fifteen-year-old artistic girl is melancholy with longing, but unexpectedly gets drawn into a wondrous adventure born of myth—behind it all lie her forgotten memories and a wager.

apps.name: 桌面小搭档 Demo
apps.short_description: This is a AI desktop companion that works and studies with you! You can choose your favorite companion to work or study with in any scenario. You can also find a favorite scenes to pause, enjoy the view. You can also decorate your desk in your favorite style and create your very own digital desk!

apps.name: 落仙泱 Demo
apps.short_description:
No spiritual root – can you still ascend?
In Luoxian Yang, five elements, demonic, and heretic cultivators walk their own paths. Play as mortal or novice – grow, advance. Master arts, refine treasures, recruit Daoists. Witness the Nine Provinces' struggles – shape their endings.

apps.name: ARK: Genesis Ascended Part 1
apps.short_description: Awaken in a fractured virtual simulation. Alongside your companion HLN-A, overcome rigorous tests across lethal biomes. Dive into a massive new ocean with dynamic water physics, master missions, and tame beasts like the Palaeoctopus!

apps.name: ARK: Lost Colony
apps.short_description: Plunge through the icy heart of darkness in ASA's first massive canonical expansion. Discover a new narratively-driven world, unlock powerful skill trees, befriend exotic tames, wear "Cursed" gear tiers, master new building systems, and build & command an army as you seek to dethrone The Lost King!

apps.name: ARK: Valguero Ascended
apps.short_description: Explore Valguero, a land where medieval legend and ancient memory entwine. Journey across ten deadly biomes, from tundra to shadowed trenches, and face predators like the swift Deinonychus and the terrifying Megaraptor. Both beautiful and brutal, Valguero will test your survival like never before.

apps.name: Ball Scratch Simulator - Scratch & Climb
apps.short_description: Scratch, charge, jump. Turn an embarrassing itch into awkward altitude across 20 illustrated platforming stages. Pick your jump strength, steer past spikes and moving ledges, collect 60 trail charms, and race your own best ghost.

apps.name: Ball Scratch Simulator - Scratch & Slay
apps.short_description: A superhero injection goes badly wrong. Fight viruses and microplastics in a ridiculous first-person dream with 10 wave arenas, six household weapons and four boss types. Dash, cool your Hover Minigun and scratch your way out of the lab.

apps.name: Juggernaut Asset Maker Pro
apps.short_description:
This is downloadable content for the retro FPS "Juggernaut".
With this tool, you can create your own original stages and bring your ideas to life.

apps.name: Warface - Хеллоуинские кошмары
apps.short_description: The hunt begins!

apps.name: 1000 MONTHS
apps.short_description: Live one life across 1,000 months. Make choices, watch time accumulate, and see how work, relationships, routines, and unexpected moments shape where your lifetime goes.

apps.name: 20th Century Warfare
apps.short_description: 20th Century Warfare is a large-scale World War II wargame spanning land, sea, and air. Command forces across massive battlefields, lead bombing raids and armored assaults, and fight through official and user-made scenarios set across the defining conflicts of the era.

apps.name: 7 Bullets
apps.short_description:
Fight animal outlaws off in strategic gunfight duels.
Collect their bounties to buy yourself the deadliest 7 bullets combos, and bring back Wolf Town to its former glory.

apps.name: Alien Deathstorm
apps.short_description: Explore a devastated off-world colony that is ravaged by a cataclysmic mega-storm and overrun by bloodthirsty aliens in a desperate fight to survive.

apps.name: AltspaceVR
apps.short_description: AltspaceVR is a social platform for virtual reality, a place where people meet inside shared 3D spaces instead of scrolling past each other.

apps.name: Another Card Game
apps.short_description: Another Card Game is a unique PvP, PvE card game. Fight your friends, your parents, your dog, your self in means to dominate the Sacred Orb. Combine your cards into powerful spells to bring down your foes. Oh and by the way did you know that every 60 seconds one minute goes by?

apps.name: ARCS
apps.short_description: A stage‑based shooter where you build optimal strategies and wipe out over a thousand enemies.

apps.name: Attack of the Astrals
apps.short_description: Turn-based strategy roguelike where every battle is a tactical puzzle. Each move of your champion trio unleashes an attack and swaps tiles with other units. Combine skills, spells and summons to defeat a cosmic army that grows stronger as you do.

apps.name: Beatlash: Survival
apps.short_description: A horde survivor that plays your music. Thousands of enemies, all moving to the beat, and when the drop hits, so do you. Put on your favourite song and watch the whole screen come apart in time with it.

apps.name: Become Emperor 2! My Trillion Beauties Universe Empire
apps.short_description: This is an interactive video game set in a cosmic empire. Explore, make choices at key moments, and embark on your own cosmic adventure.
developers: 万亿美女星球工程设计研究院
publishers: 万亿美女星球工程设计研究院

apps.name: Blademash
apps.short_description: An ultra fast-paced 2D arena brawler for 1–4 players with a roguelike twist, made for couch multiplayer fun or competitive online matches. Pick a race and a class, each with its own playstyle, then draft items between battles to build a unique fighter. New races and classes unlock as you play.

apps.name: BloomTale
apps.short_description: BloomTale is a cozy flower shop simulation game where creativity meets management. Arrange beautiful flower compositions, manage your shop, and satisfy your customers in a magical world of blooming potential.

apps.name: Bohnice: Within The Mind
apps.short_description: Uncover the dark secrets of Prague's Bohnice Asylum. As an investigative journalist, you must document forbidden experiments and chilling paranormal encounters. Collect photographic evidence and survive the horrifying truth hidden for 40 years.

apps.name: Book Nook
apps.short_description: Build miniature diorama scenes, piece by piece. Complete beautiful book nooks as you place furniture, decorations, and small details. Relax and enjoy the peaceful satisfaction of every detail falling into place, as you discover more about each moment in time.

apps.name: Breakaway
apps.short_description: Soccer set in Space. Juggle, Curl, and Save the ball. Offline or Online, from 1v1 to 6v6.

apps.name: Breakneck Transmission
apps.short_description: A fast-paced, time trial package delivery racing game. Using mind bending warps to the laws of physics, deliver packages to their destinations quickly and prove that recklessness can be improved to regain a spot on a top racing team.

apps.name: BULLETJUMP
apps.short_description: Jump with one hand, shoot with the other. BULLETJUMP is a fast arcade score-chaser: weave through bullet storms, skim close calls to push your multiplier to x5, and chase the player one rank above you. Watch any run back, take on a new Daily Challenge every day, and climb the global leaderboards.

apps.name: Car Crime Simulator
apps.short_description: Steal cars, set up secret stashes, sell vehicles for big profits on demand, or strip them for parts. Build your criminal empire solo or team up with others in co-op mode.

apps.name: CHAPA CHAPA Munchkin Mafia
apps.short_description: CHAPA CHAPA Munchkin Mafia is a third-person fighting game centered on the mafia, in which you must build up your own gang and defeat all your enemies.

apps.name: Chef's Adventure
apps.short_description: Tomorrow is Harry's birthday. The Chef only wants to bake a simple cake, but the chickens have broken out and cleared out the whole pantry. Chase them through 5 worlds and 10 levels, learn new moves along the way and get the cake on the table.

apps.name: Cinderwake
apps.short_description: A dark action RPG with click-to-move combat, deep loot and five classes with their own skill trees. Fight through four acts of random maps alone or with up to 8 players online. Three world levels and the endless Pyre. Loot, die, return.

apps.name: Clean Memories
apps.short_description: Clean, repair, and organize forgotten spaces. Uncover the memories hidden beneath the dirt in this relaxing first-person cleaning adventure.

apps.name: Clown House: Lunacy
apps.short_description:
A narrative horror experience where violence is a trap.

Unravel the secrets of a derelict mansion and its uncanny clown residents. Solve puzzles. Observe the clowns, deduct their needs and what angers them to survive.

And never harm the residents of the Clown House. It has eyes.

apps.name: Cold Salvage
apps.short_description: A co-op horror investigation game. You're salvage engineers sent aboard derelict ships to find what's nesting in the dark and identify it before it finds you. Gather evidence, keep your crew calm, and get out alive. You can't kill it. You can only name it.

apps.name: Conjoined
apps.short_description: Step into a relaxing world where you stack and merge magical ingredients. Toss herbs, crystals, and curious finds into a bubbling cauldron to gain essence, travel through the portal to discover new cards and mechanics, enjoy a cozy, stress free magical experience.

apps.name: Culdcept BEGINS
apps.short_description: A hidden classic that fuses board and card games, Culdcept features a unique, innovative system that has captivated fans since its debut. Players become Cepters, wielding cards in intense battles where luck and strategy collide. After ten years, a brand-new story begins once again.

apps.name: Dinolords
apps.short_description: Dinolords combines real-time strategy, city-building and action RPG combat in the genre hybrid Hack’n’Strat. Build your stronghold, command human and dinosaur armies and fight as the lord shaping a new age of warfare.

apps.name: Disaster Crew
apps.short_description: Disaster Crew is a co-op action-adventure for up to four players. Take on unusual contracts, explore locations packed with traps and obstacles, and share an adventure filled with unexpected dangers and spectacular events..

apps.name: Doubtbound
apps.short_description: A turn-based RPG of hidden betrayal. Battle through branching encounters, uncover the traitor within your party, and overthrow the Mad Monarch in multiplayer or solo investigation mode.

apps.name: DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 3
apps.short_description: DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 3 is a wholly-new Dragon Ball experience, where you decide the hero you want to be in an unexplored Dragon Ball world: AGE 1000.

apps.name: Drill Deep
apps.short_description: Drill Deep is a coalpunk idle clicker about digging the world's deepest hole. You start with a cozy incremental loop, descend into madness of haunted mine and end somewhere you shouldn't have gone

apps.name: Eldramoor: Haven in the Mist
apps.short_description: Gather your friends, or make new ones, as you forge your destiny in Eldramoor, a bold new VR MMO. Master your crafting abilities, level up your combat skills, explore five unique regions, or just socialize at the local tavern. Whatever you bring to the community, you have a home in Eldramoor.

apps.name: Elyrion - The Secret Book
apps.short_description: Set in the world of Elyrion, this adventure takes place just before the events of the upcoming Rise of the Raven. Elyrion – The Secret Book is a 2D stylized RPG that offers not only main and side quests, but a wide range of challenges and discoveries for players to explore.

apps.name: Endless FPV
apps.short_description: Fly fast, react on the fly, and master an endless FPV course that changes every run. Mix course segments from themed decks, build your own custom deck, and customize your drone to match your flying style.

apps.name: Endless Valkyrie
apps.short_description: Endless Valkyrie is a 2D pixel idle RPG inspired by Nordic mythology. Guide a Valkyrie through automatic exploration and combat, configure skills and gear, cross three regions, challenge Bosses, forge equipment, claim Offline Rewards, and Rebirth to preserve permanent growth.

apps.name: Fairy Comedy: A Love Hard To Find
apps.short_description: 只能复述别人话语的鹦鹉精灵，该怎样向喜欢的女孩表达心意？扮演不谙世事的李素武，收集语句卡牌，在约会中努力接上她的话，也可能一不小心说出令人啼笑皆非的怪话！在这段融入轻度卡牌互动的恋爱视觉小说中，与徐清茗从相识走向相恋，在欢笑、心动与成长中，寻找属于自己的幸福。

apps.name: Fearwoods
apps.short_description: Fearwoods is a 4 co-op survival horror where light and silence are your only weapons. Explore the cursed forest, uncover Aveline’s story, evade a relentless demon, and fight for escape before the darkness consumes you.

apps.name: Fiets-Together
apps.short_description: Fiets-Together is a chaotic co-op bike game for 2-4 players where each of you controls one shoe on a pedal. Together, you control the bike's acceleration and steering. Agree on which path to ride, chase best times, customize your shoe and try to preserve your friendship.

apps.name: Finals Week
apps.short_description: A 1-4 player co-op cheating simulator where you and your friends try to survive the final week of exams. Steal answers, elude the teacher, and use every tool in your cheating arsenal to graduate from school without studying a single page.

apps.name: Fool's Metal
apps.short_description: Fool's Metal is a destruction-fueled platformer where every jump breaks the ground, and every environment is fully destructible. Mine, body-slam, and explode your way through handcrafted levels that are begging to be destroyed.

apps.name: FreeStyle Football 2
apps.short_description:
Freestyle Football 2 is a fast-paced, 5v5 match-based online multiplayer soccer game.
Each position has a unique role, and you'll utilize a variety of strategies and skills to achieve victory with your team.
Stylish play and unique characters transform the pitch into a stage.

apps.name: GAEKGWI
apps.short_description: A first-person Korean folk horror game set in a fog-bound old village that weaves itself anew every time you enter. You cannot fight. Stay low, listen closely and save your lantern oil as you slip past ghosts from Korean folklore and search for the way home.

apps.name: GayTeA VI
apps.short_description: A cozy, very gay idle clicker about keeping one cup of tea hot. Click it to heat it, hold to pet it, fill a whole kitchen with things that talk back, pour out the pot for tea leaves, and keep the brew going while you are away. Cozy, silly, a little cheeky.

apps.name: Grand Theft Auto V Legacy
apps.short_description: Grand Theft Auto V for PC offers players the option to explore the award-winning world of Los Santos and Blaine County in resolutions of up to 4k and beyond, as well as the chance to experience the game running at 60 frames per second.

apps.name: Guildrun
apps.short_description: A PvE roguelike autobattler with no timers, no queue and no PvP. Draft a guild, rank heroes from C to S and stack 300+ relics into builds that one-shot bosses. Climb 8 difficulties and the Endless leaderboards. Start small, become unstoppable.

apps.name: GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT
apps.short_description: Become the pilot you were born to be. Change humanity’s fate in GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT, a high-mobility action game that delivers a bold new take on Gundam, blending a fast-paced cinematic story with intense, hard-hitting combat in an all-new universe.

apps.name: Heirs of the Fountains
apps.short_description: Heirs of the Fountains is a pixel-art action-platformer starring two siblings with unique powers. Explore the kingdom of Elarion, overcome dangerous levels, defeat fearsome creatures and legendary bosses, and rescue Lady Julia from the clutches of the witch Morwenna.

apps.name: Hoarder
apps.short_description: Clean. Possess. Control. Hoarder begins as a mundane cleaning simulator that spirals into a distant nightmare. Scavenge the hoarders’ house, recover what should be forgotten, and if you go far enough, you might reach the top of the pyramid or the bottom of the abyss.

apps.name: HODKA
apps.short_description: Roam a wild map with your trusty metal detector to dig up scrap. Upgrade your van and tools for better loot but finish work before nightfall. For that is when the dark fog creeps in and will claim its due.

apps.name: Idle Purrates Clicker
apps.short_description: Build a fearless feline crew, plunder treasure-filled shores, flip mysterious coins and upgrade your way to fortune! Conquer each beach, blast enemy ships and become the richest purrate captain the seven seas have ever seen.

apps.name: In-Security
apps.short_description: Hack into cameras, watch your hotwife, and use temptation as a tool to expose the truth behind a corporate heist. NTS/NTR unavoidable!

apps.name: Inearth
apps.short_description: A tactical turn-based roguelite with environmental interactions, spellcrafting, and deckbuilding. Descend into the Hollow Earth. As above, so below.

apps.name: InFlood
apps.short_description: Raise your sails and set forth across an endless ocean, vast and perilous, filled with submerged mysteries and unexpected adventures. Fight your way through danger, upgrade your ship, recruit a crew, explore the world, and decide which coalitions to support—and what will be built upon the ruins.

apps.name: INTERSCAPE
apps.short_description: A colossal black sphere has appeared on Earth, trapping humanity in endless dreams. Explore surreal dream worlds, uncover hidden secrets, and awaken those who sleep. In each distinct dream, awaken new abilities and experience unique worlds.

apps.name: JackParts
apps.short_description: When the signal sounds, be the fastest! JackParts is an online party battle game for up to 4 players. Win gun parts with quick reflexes, assemble your weapon, and turn the tables with battle items. Even death isn’t the end—the Death Roulette can change your final score.

apps.name: Juggernaut
apps.short_description: Looks retro. Plays retro. Because it is retro.Jump back to the ’90s and blast those demons straight back to hell in this fast-paced, old-school FPS!And the carnage doesn’t stop there—load up maps created by other players and dive into even more action-packed adventures.

apps.name: Keep on Digging!
apps.short_description: Dig up chests, collect loot, and spend your gold on new skills and gear in Keep on Digging.

apps.name: Kena: Scars of Kosmora
apps.short_description: Kena’s journey to cure her affliction leads to the island of Kosmora, plagued by its own mysterious corruption. To protect Kosmora, she must master the elements with the aid of spirit companions and dynamic combat in this action-packed yet heartfelt adventure.

apps.name: Kingmakers
apps.short_description: Go back in time to a war-torn medieval era with a vast arsenal of modern weapons, change the course of history, and save the future in this epic action/strategy sandbox. Build your kingdom, grab a gun, and lead an army of thousands into massive, real-time simulated battles — solo or in co-op.

apps.name: KittenRush
apps.short_description: A nonstop rush of bite-sized mini-games with an adorable pixel kitten! Run breathless and chase every trophy!

apps.name: Korsaros Online
apps.short_description: Sail the Aegean Sea in a free-to-play 3D naval MMORPG inspired by Greek mythology. Explore an open Mediterranean world, build your ship, recruit a Captain and crew, battle pirates, fish, hunt treasure and trade with players. Brave PvP waters or sail together.

apps.name: Lazare's Sacrifice
apps.short_description: The guillotine awaits. Your only escape? A deck of cards. Play for your life against legends of the French Revolution in this gripping narrative deckbuilder. Solve puzzles in the depths of prison to uncover the truth of your captivity. Cards, health, sanity... What will you sacrifice to survive?

apps.name: Liberators Inc.
apps.short_description: Governments are gone. The goddamn bugs are everywhere. And somebody has to get rid of them! Enter the Liberators: mercenary crews that survivors of the bugapolypse hire to exterminate the vile Swarm. Grab your weapons, get yourself a vehicle, team up with your friends, and get rich or die trying!

apps.name: Life Is a Dungeon: Lean into It.
apps.short_description: Choose one of four adventurers, each driven to clear dungeon floors in a different way. Set a destination or take direct control, then combine equipment with powerful—but sometimes troublesome—random skills to shape every expedition in this dungeon-crawling roguelite RPG.

apps.name: LitGirls: Bookbound Dungeons
apps.short_description: LitGirls: Bookbound Dungeons is a dungeon-crawler RPG where classic literature meets anime Girls! Assemble a party inspired by legendary characters such as Alice, Juliet, Dante, and Raven, then lead them into treacherous dungeons crawling with monsters, traps, treasure, and otherworldly horrors.

apps.name: Little Cheese Works
apps.short_description: [Co-op Action × Voice Chat] Work together to carry cheese without waking the cat! Use voice chat—but be careful, even small sounds can alert it. As overworked mice in a shady company, can you overcome traps and escape to a peaceful life?

apps.name: Lucremachine
apps.short_description: An oddly satisfying incremental roguelike: flip coins to earn money, invest it all back into skills, upgrades, coins, and more as your fortune snowballs into the trillions! Hoard relics from encounters, get rich by midnight to get game-breaking boons, and whatever you do... do NOT anger Gregory.

apps.name: Magicians: The Devil's Deal
apps.short_description: Magicians: The Devil’s Deal is a narrative driven FPS where stage magic becomes real. You play as Jacob Menteuro, a fallen illusionist bound by a pact with The Devil and cast into Hell. Master deadly tricks, steal the powers of rival magicians, and escape the infernal world of Theatreland.

apps.name: Magtiles
apps.short_description: Magtiles is a chill and relaxing puzzle game about moving tiles. There's no rush! Just play at your own pace, disable the move limit, skip levels, or come back later if you just want to relax. Listen to chill lo-fi and classical music and satisfying sounds. Simple is good.

apps.name: Makina
apps.short_description: In a world where Emotion is energy, a vengeful pilot boards a dangerous, desire-fueled Makina and descends into the emotion-addicted city. Defy the twisted rulers—a scientist, architect, K-pop idol, and director—to tear down their grand plan. A hybrid adventure of mech action and stealth: [MAKINA].

apps.name: Midgardr
apps.short_description: A board game where you play as a Duke sent to build and protect a village at the edge of the realm. Every choice you make will shape its future. But be aware: the board itself may not be all it seems... Will your village thrive or crumble beneath truths yet unknown? Are you really just... a Duke?

apps.name: Mind Vessel
apps.short_description: An autobattler roguelike in which you are a Vessel formed by the unification of dead people's spirits. Dismember and graft them to customize their abilities, as you use them to find a way out of the void.

apps.name: Minimal AI Build Shop 24-26
apps.short_description: Run a tiny PC shop through the 2024–26 AI boom. Pick the GPU, parts and model that fit each customer's budget. A light, cozy pixel-art shop sim.

apps.name: MoonTraum
apps.short_description: *MoonTraum* is a fishing game set in a mysterious dream world. Lost in a world where dreams take the form of fish, you meet Welt, a cat fisherman, and begin your fishing adventure. Catch uniquely designed fish and complete your collection!

apps.name: My Little Empire: Cyber Lounge
apps.short_description: Build your own computer club from an empty lot: rows of gaming PCs, console and VR corners, a bar and a kitchen. Hire staff, keep gamers happy, deal with 21 city factions — and don't forget to pet Luna, the club cat.

apps.name: Nailcrown
apps.short_description: Nailcrown is a savage dark-fantasy boomer shooter packed with high-velocity gunplay, brutal melee action, and a dynamic gore system. Explore the dark environments and wield a deadly arsenal, while taking down a horde of accursed enemies. Fast, violent, and unapologetically old-school.

apps.name: NARNOK: Feed Grommy Candy
apps.short_description:
A push-your-luck roguelike sackbuilder where you feed candy to a worm called Grommy.
Draw candies from your sack, chain their effects, and feed Gromintler BUT NOT TOO SWEET!

apps.name: Night Cart: The Immortal Plague
apps.short_description: A first-person gothic adventure where you drive a horse-drawn cart through plague-ridden Transylvania alongside an immortal woman, exploring forgotten places, battling desperate foes, uncovering ancient secrets, and searching for the legendary Count Saint Germain.

apps.name: NO SUNRISE
apps.short_description: Survive the night in NO SUNRISE, a 2.5D zombie survival shooter for solo play and co-op with up to 8 players. Barricade windows, open new routes, upgrade your weapons and rescue your team as each wave turns up the pressure.

apps.name: NTR Tales - The Elf Next Stream
apps.short_description: An adult RPG about love, streaming, and corruption. Help your elven girlfriend rebuild her lost memories, grow her audience, and repay your debt, one stream at a time.

apps.name: NyanGO
apps.short_description: A 4×4 "push-style Go" played with adorable cat pieces. Place, move, and push—surround your opponent's cats to win. Pushed cats get stunned, and a cat stunned 3 times shatters! Easy to learn, deep to master. Play online or challenge the CPU.

apps.name: Online: 404
apps.short_description: An open-world survival simulator where even seasoned veterans of the genre will have to rethink their typical survival approach and how they interact with the world around them. Play solo or with friends, follow the story or simply explore — just don’t forget your most important gadget.

apps.name: Ostfriesland Games
apps.short_description: Ostfriesland Games turns road bowling, ditch vaulting, mudflat sled racing, shrimp peeling and tea serving into a retro arcade game. With real places in pixel art, local and worldwide high scores, and East Frisian humour. Even making tea can get hectic.

apps.name: Out of the Shadows
apps.short_description: Out of the Shadows is a 2–4 player online co-op horror escape game. Explore unsettling locations, uncover their stories, solve cooperative and asymmetric puzzles, and survive the hostile inhabitants of places your team was never meant to enter.

apps.name: Pack a Plush!
apps.short_description: Pack a Plush! is a cozy collection game where you buy batches of adorable plushies, organize them into displays, and build valuable collections. Discover legendary plushies, fulfill requests, and create a collection that's uniquely yours.

apps.name: Pingo
apps.short_description: Pingo is an AI desktop pet that chats, roasts, remembers, and helps with tasks. Connect local models, official cloud; customize personality, voice, and look; let it observe your screen, keep memory and diary notes, use Skills, knowledge bases, and MCP, and play games with you.

apps.name: Pocket Aquarium 方寸水族
apps.short_description: Build your own cozy desktop aquarium. Collect dozens of charming fish, shrimp and snails, decorate with plants, rocks, lighting and substrate, and watch your little creatures swim, forage and grow. Unlock rare, dreamlike fish — or set them free to drift across your desktop.

apps.name: Punch Upon a Time
apps.short_description: Punch Upon a Time is a team-based party fighter inspired by Smash Bros where you take on rounds of modes, mini-games, and combat alongside your friends. Assemble a squad of the biggest fairy tale names to punch, dunk, fly, score, and sumo your way to victory as the LAST TEAM STANDING.

apps.name: puzzlez - a shapez game
apps.short_description: puzzlez - a shapez game is an easy to learn, hard to master puzzle game about building shapes in compact 3D spaces. Solve handcrafted puzzles with multiple solutions, from simple production chains to complex logistical problems. Design, share, and play custom puzzles with an ever-growing community.

apps.name: Queen's Domain
apps.short_description: A retro-fantasy action RPG with brutal combat and traversal-focused exploration. Embark on a quest to find your father who disappeared on the mysterious Isle of Neasied, where sinister forces gather, secrets hide everywhere, and the sleeping Queen has begun to stir…

apps.name: Rahasya: The Curse of Ooty
apps.short_description: You drove her from the city to Ooty. Something followed her into the car. Now she is possessed, and an aghori in the hills will only help if you bring him what he asks for. First-person Indian folk horror.

apps.name: RAT CITY: Ratocracy
apps.short_description: Build and Manage a Rat City. Run it into the ground. Literally. Keep your Rats happy and productive. Create for them a glorious colony in the dirt! The never ending demand for the production of products to consume is all consuming. Wait, is this real life? No, it's RAT CITY!

apps.name: ROB RUN
apps.short_description: ROB RUN is a brutal crime sandbox featuring thousands of players. Rise above everyone through the grit, the grime, and the struggle. Break free and take yourself from squalor by any means.

apps.name: Rubber Messiah: 18+ Lust Bunker Simulator
apps.short_description: Clock in for a logistical nightmare. Deliver cargo to an underground cult obsessed with 18+ absurdity. Dodge industrial sex hazards, find the Supreme Mother Womb, and get your invoice signed. Maintain your deadpan sanity. Just get the signature and leave!

apps.name: Samhan: Where Korea Began
apps.short_description: Silla's thousand-year reign is crumbling, and Gyeon Hwon, Gung Ye and Wang Geon rise to claim the peninsula. Command 500+ historical figures across a 3D Korea in this turn-based grand strategy of statecraft, diplomacy and war—and reunite the Three Han.

apps.name: Scraplings
apps.short_description: A 2D side-view recycling and automation game set above an infinite trash sea. Salvage waste left behind from the Lost Century, process it through advanced production lines, and grow your factory to keep it afloat in this harsh ecosystem while paying your rent on time.

apps.name: Seleka-san who Exposes unnoticed with Naked Coat
apps.short_description:
Experience humanity’s greatest dilemma: “I want to expose more!” vs. “The more daring the exposure, the easier it is to get caught!”
Watch where people are and where they’re looking, push things right to the limit, and complete exposure missions in this fresh 3D stealth exhibitionism action game.

apps.name: Sheepdog Simulator
apps.short_description: Learn to herd sheep the way real shepherds do: with a whistle and a faithful sheepdog. Send your dog wide around the flock, then ease them down the lane and through the gate. Push too hard and fear spreads until they bolt; hang back and they wander off to graze. Bring every last one home.

apps.name: Shroom & Blade
apps.short_description: Two players. One mushroom colony. One explores, fights ants, and hunts scouts before they summon stronger waves. The other builds, automates, and fortifies the colony. Survive escalating attacks together until the Ant Queen arrives in this asymmetric co-op base-defense game.

apps.name: SHUNYA
apps.short_description: One moves, one draws—you control both at once. In this pixel-art puzzle game, draw Earth, Water, Fire, and Wind magic cubes to reshape the environment. Bound by a magical chain, a girl and a floating cat must escape the mysterious Otherworld and find their way home.

apps.name: Skyward Masters
apps.short_description: SKYWARD MASTERS is an ARENA FPS with Bedwars-style strategy, where 16 players split across 4 teams fight on floating islands. Set across changing biomes you outlast your opponents to be the last team standing in a format where chaos reigns and teamwork rules.

apps.name: Slasher Manager
apps.short_description: Become the slasher in a darkly comic horror clicker set inside a killer’s hand-drawn notebook. Turn Screams into ridiculous upgrades, chain combos, and automate the hunt—then take on bosses that change the rules. Nine locations. One very questionable career.

apps.name: SOLITAIRE.EXE
apps.short_description: Remember Windows Solitaire? Build outrageous combos in a solitaire roguelike, then open ZONE.EXE and destroy your friends in real-time card mayhem. Install plugins, beat the quota and survive the performance reviews. Your night shift starts here.

apps.name: Space Savory
apps.short_description:
Not that far away, in a galaxy…

A diner with questionable hygiene, bubbling with dark secrets and darker humor, in the middle of cosmic nothingness.

Welcome to Space Savory. Don’t be fooled by appearances, the best flavor in the universe is cooked right here.

(Only within the observable part.)

apps.name: Speed Golf Royale
apps.short_description: Ready, set, swing! Whack the ball and dash through chaotic courses. Scored on shots taken and how fast you reach the flag. Outplay your rivals in a fast-paced, fun scramble to victory!

apps.name: SPEED OF LIGHT
apps.short_description: Start with a fragile ship drifting through deep space and evolve into a physics-defying machine. Upgrade thrusters, harvest particles, vaporize enemies, and race toward the speed of light in this action space incremental game.

apps.name: SPINE
apps.short_description:
SPINE is a single-player action game about close-quarters gunfights with aesthetics of Gun Fu movies.
Step into the stunning cyberpunk world with rebellious street artist Redline and her sentient combat implant Spine as they defy the autocratic AI regime in search of Redline's captured brother.

apps.name: Spirit of Diwata
apps.short_description: Heal instead of fight. A cozy co-op JRPG for up to three, on one screen or online, set in an Asian fantasy world where you play elemental spirit instruments to calm the creatures you meet. Every creature is someone to bond with, and each friendship brings a little more hope to the world.

apps.name: STOREBOT: Tidy Up PC Parts
apps.short_description: Organize thousands of PC parts, complete shelves, unlock powerful upgrades, and work together with friends to tidy up a chaotic computer store. Carry, throw, and sort boxes across two unique maps while building your perfect store.

apps.name: Streets of Fortuna
apps.short_description: Survive in a giant simulated historical city. Grow from a street rat to a tradesman, a priest, a smuggler, an alchemist, a spy, or perhaps someday a leader to rival the Overlord. A free-roaming sandbox megasim RPG set in a fantasy Constantinople.

apps.name: Strip Bubbles: Maidens of the Castle of Lust
apps.short_description: Enter the Castle of Lust in this sensual dark fantasy arcade bubble shooter! Defeat 4 captivating maidens, strip them sphere by sphere, and unlock interactive private chambers featuring high-definition videos and intense, explicit climaxes.

apps.name: Strip Bubbles: Rich Ladies Club
apps.short_description: Enter the exclusive Rich Ladies Club! Challenge four powerful, ultra-wealthy heiresses in addictive bubble-shooter matches: a strict lawyer with forbidden desires, a casino countess, an innocent noblewoman seeking sin, and an oil princess. Master the art of high-society seduction.

apps.name: Sturmjäger
apps.short_description: Sturmjäger is a sci-fi shoot 'em up built for pure, adrenaline-fueled arcade action. Obliterate everything in sight, and master 10 unique missions solo or in local couch co-op. High-octane action, merciless boss fights await. Simple rules: If it moves, shoot it. If it doesn't... shoot it anyway!

apps.name: Sunset Painter
apps.short_description: Have you ever wanted to spray an entire can of whipped cream into the sky and watch the sun's golden rays dance through your masterpiece as day melts into dusk? Craft the perfect sky - spray, sculpt, and swirl volumetric clouds with delightfully tactile tools. No pressure, just you and the sky.

apps.name: Tapis
apps.short_description: Tapis is a score-chasing roguelike played on a game table. Tokens fall onto the board, each with its own effect based on its position and family. Your goal: score a huge amount of points.  To help you, you'll have repositioning moves to strategically place your tokens and maximize your score.

apps.name: The Little Stomping Girl
apps.short_description: Tiny stomps. Explosive combos! Mine ore before your match burns out in this incremental mining game. Fit gear into limited equipment slots, collect unique items, and combine skills to turn a little girl's stomps into powerful chain reactions. Light another match, grow stronger, and dig deeper!

apps.name: The Peasants Are Coming!
apps.short_description: You are the nobility. They are everyone else. Tens of thousands of furious peasants pour down the roads at your granary, your treasury and your gate. Hire the watch, raise a circus, hang a few, and break their leaders before they reach your throne.

apps.name: The Rotting Chronicles
apps.short_description: The Rotting Chronicles is a survival action game set in a zombie-ravaged city where you must fight, scavenge, craft, and rebuild to survive. Run solo or with up to 3 friends as you grow your survival skills and find the best strategy to survive.

apps.name: TheDowsing / ダウジング
apps.short_description: You have entered a sealed gold mine, dreaming of a fortune. All you can rely on is your dowsing rod. Is it gold that lies beyond your reaction, or is it......?

apps.name: Theos: Cities Of Myth
apps.short_description: A modern take on classic city-builders, Theos: Cities of Myth lets you develop a thriving metropolis dedicated to one of 7 Greek Deities. Raise an imposing sanctuary, meet your citizens’ needs, and found a city worthy of the Gods.

apps.name: Tiny Desk Pot
apps.short_description: Grow and nourish your own vegetables in a tiny desk pot! Let your leafy companion grow idle in a corner of your desktop while you do your things. Discover new soils, unlock new types of vegetables, and customize your pot with cute stickers. Relaxing music included!

apps.name: Trailblazers: Into the March
apps.short_description: Embark on a thrilling adventure in this roguelite colony-sim strategy game. Command your Landship in tactical battles, care for a crew composed of all sorts of characters, shape your home, manage resources, and lead expeditions into the March. Discover what lies at its heart... and in yours.

apps.name: Troublemaker 3
apps.short_description: The Fight Comes from Anyone. Three years after Troublemaker 2, Jayakarta still stands under a long-standing political dynasty, but the people are starting to fight back. Citizens, stars, gangsters, and even those within the justice system unite in this fun open-world action-comedy beat-'em-up game.

apps.name: Two & Two: Agents
apps.short_description: Play as two secret agents investigating a scientist’s mysterious experiment. Communicate, exchange clues and solve cooperative puzzles where one agent has a piece and the other knows where it fits.

apps.name: VectorForce
apps.short_description: Arm yourselves as ace agents and engage in high-octane light-gun action in this retro-inspired arcade rail shooter. Take on a ruthless criminal organisation shooting down waves of enemies and challenging bosses that will put your reflexes to the test while the city is on the brink of crisis.

apps.name: Voxel Playground
apps.short_description: A highly moddable destructible physics sandbox. Built for VR and non-VR.

apps.name: Warlapse
apps.short_description: War isn't heroism — it's ruthless order and maneuver. Across 7 ages from the Stone Age to modern times, encircle the enemy, cut their supply, and break morale to melt them in the killbox. Lead veterans through Campaign, dive into fast Skirmishes, or mod tomorrow's wars with your own units!

apps.name: We Harvest Shadows
apps.short_description: A single-player, first-person farming horror allegory. Become a recluse, build up your farm, and survive the lonely nights.

apps.name: We'll Meet Again
apps.short_description: When someone takes their own life, the pain doesn't end with them. It passes to those left behind. A short story about the guilt, anger and unanswered questions of the people who stay.

apps.name: Where the Seeds Fall
apps.short_description: Blight has infected the land, forcing humanity to live upon the branches of the World Tree. After a chance encounter with a strange child, your world begins to fall apart. Navigate ruins, read the wind, and take a leap of faith into this thrilling action-adventure game.

apps.name: WILD DECK
apps.short_description: Wild Deck is a fast-paced asymmetric hide-and-seek action game where a group of players transform into animals, choosing their form from random cards, while a single armed hunter tries to track them all down and eliminate them.

apps.name: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember
apps.short_description:
Born from war's flames, a Phoenix ascends.
In this dark fantasy Three Kingdoms action RPG from Team NINJA, players use offensive and defensive Chinese martial arts to fight back against mighty demons on the battlefields of the Three Kingdoms.

apps.name: World Of Arena
apps.short_description: This game is an Open World RPG, where you venture into a world to find combat portals and platformers, to get stronger and fight the final boss!!v

apps.name: You Have Been Deleted
apps.short_description: You Have Been Deleted is a first-person survival horror inspired by the early internet and the 90s, all packaged in a surreal retro art style. Trapped within a corrupted virtual reality made by the company you work for, you must Uncover, Hack, and Survive if you ever wish to free yourself from hell.

apps.name: Пока помню
apps.short_description: An adventure game about an artist who has lost her sight and must learn to live in the unfamiliar, dark and frightening world that has become her reality

apps.name: 侠不义·昙花一线
apps.short_description: A wuxia roguelike deckbuilder with loot and extraction. Turn martial arts into card tactics: strikes beat feints, feints beat guards, and guards beat strikes. Outsmart your foes, refine your deck, and steadily build a powerful band of heroes. Victory rewards strategy, not reflexes!

apps.name: 叫魂JIAOHUN
apps.short_description: Welcome to JIAOHUN. Today is Dec 31, 1999. Happy New Year. And a message from Fairy Town's end. Grab your pager and step into the strange night before the new millennium. Investigate the mysterious Fairy Town in Baishoi County. Explore deeper, uncover the townfolk's secrets, and find the dark truth.

apps.name: 抽号小队
apps.short_description: A strategy game blending deckbuilding, auto-battler, and roguelike elements. Recruit and upgrade units to build your squad. Draw random numbers to activate matching units’ skills on the board, earn points, and defeat the boss. Test your strategy and arrangement — with a little luck.

apps.name: 数织艺术
apps.short_description: Classic & variant nonogram puzzles with a collectible twist: solve number puzzles, piece fragments together, and light up themed albums.

apps.name: 추 : 그날의 악몽
apps.short_description: The nightmare every Korean veteran knows: years after your discharge, you wake up back in the barracks. By day, an absurdly ordinary army routine. After lights-out, search the base while avoiding “him”, who is still awake. A first-person comedy-horror adventure over three days in the Korean army.
